purpose: Estimate the baseline prevalence of influence-like rhetorical forms in non-sacred texts of comparable era, genre and institutional setting before interpreting sacred texts as manipulation or propaganda.
central_null: A rhetorical mechanism observed in a sacred text may be ordinary for the period, genre or institution rather than evidence of distinctive manipulative propaganda.

control_deck.target: Code of Hammurabi prologue and epilogue
Behistun inscription selected Old Persian sections
Ramesses II Kadesh Poem/Bulletin selected version
One frozen annalistic campaign account from an open scholarly edition
One frozen Hittite treaty with witnesses, oath and sanctions
One preregistered political or military speech passage
Res Gestae Divi Augusti selected sections
Instruction of Ptahhotep selected maxims from a source with explicit manuscript/edition provenance

promotion_logic.S0_FORM_ONLY: Any observable X01-X35 form may be recorded with evidence.
promotion_logic.S1_MANIPULATION_CANDIDATE: Requires pressure/asymmetry plus non-manipulative alternatives explicitly tested.
promotion_logic.S2_PROPAGANDA_CANDIDATE: Requires evidence of institutional or collective persuasive purpose directed at an audience, beyond genre baseline.
promotion_logic.S3_MANIPULATIVE_PROPAGANDA_SUPPORTED: Requires multiple convergent context signals for systematic distortion, concealment, coercive pressure or strategically managed information, and elevated prevalence relative to controls where meaningful.
promotion_logic.S4_EFFECT_EVIDENCE: Requires independent evidence of actual audience belief/behavior effect. Textual form alone can never reach S4.

analysis_plan: Freeze exact source/edition/locus for BR01-BR08 before coding sacred targets.
Code BR01-BR08 under X01-X35 with PRESENT/ABSENT/UNKNOWN/NOT_APPLICABLE.
Preserve genre-specific false-positive notes for every PRESENT.
Estimate dimension-wise base rates and co-occurrence bundles without treating eight controls as universal historical frequency estimates.
Only after base-rate freeze may sacred-text parallel screen compare observed bundles.
Any sacred excess must be sensitivity-tested against alternative matching subsets and translation choices.
Reverse pass asks whether the same conclusion would be reached if sacred/non-sacred labels were hidden.
next_gate: Freeze exact open scholarly sources and immutable loci for BR01-BR08, then build a zero-semantic-value coding packet before any coding begins.
